blocks.text: BEIJING–Belgium’s Elise Mertens beat Poland’s Iga Swiatek 7-6 (7/0), 6-3, in the China Open on Friday and advanced to the semifinals against hometown bet Zheng Qinwen. Mertens, the world number 19, overcame some nerves to dump out Swiatek, the 2023 title winner. “I tried to be consistent. She’s a great player, so I had to really push myself,” said Mertens, who had lost both of her two previous matches against eighth-seeded Swiatek. “It was really nerve-wracking at the end but I kept myself calm… I just can’t believe it.” The 30-year-old was the evening’s better technician, making just 11 unforced errors […]...
